{{velocity wiki="false"}} ## The results of the table of the SOP Manager: the results of the live table source of the SOP documents, with the ## actions available on each document: starting the review of the imported documents, for the users who can edit them. #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' && "$!request.outputSyntax" == 'plain') #set ($map = {}) #gridresult_buildJSON('SOPManager.Code.ControlledDocumentClass' $request.collist.split(',') $map) #set ($startReview = $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('sopManager.addPage.button.label'))) #set ($startReviewHint = $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('sopManager.addPage.hint'))) #foreach ($row in $map.rows) #set ($actions = '') #if ($row.doc_viewable) #set ($rowDocument = $xwiki.getDocument($row.doc_fullName)) #set ($rowObject = $rowDocument.getObject('SOPManager.Code.ControlledDocumentClass')) #set ($canEdit = $services.security.authorization.hasAccess('edit', $rowDocument.documentReference)) #if ($rowObject && $rowObject.getValue('status') == 'imported' && $rowObject.getValue('isInReview') != 1 && $canEdit) #set ($actions = "<button type=""button"" class=""btn btn-default btn-xs sopStartReview"" title=""$startReviewHint"" data-document=""$escapetool.xml($row.doc_fullName)"">$startReview</button>") #end #end #set ($row.sopActions = $actions) #end #jsonResponse($map) #end {{/velocity}}
